notes: R50 000 paid to a personal service trust (code 3601, G21 p. 31). SARS Other Employment Tax Deduction Tables (PAYE-GEN-01-G01-A06) row 6, Personal Service Provider: deduct 45% for a trust, so PAYE = 45% x 50 000 = 22500.00. UIF nil: UICA s1 excludes from "remuneration" any amount in paragraph (cA) of the "gross income" definition (amounts received by a personal service provider).
